qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Global #1 in ostomy (~38-40% share) and continence care (~40% share). Sustained 19%+ GAAP ROIC and 27-30% EBIT margins via recurring consumable replacement and premium innovation tiers (SenSura Mio, Luja).
